summary: A manager checks whether a meal rule actually applies at {workplace}.
realLife: Collins had received free meals at a previous store. Headquarters could not confirm whether the prohibition applied at her new location, and the investigator stopped questioning her.
gates: The case record identifies the prior workplace practice and headquarters response for current location.
inGame: needs: prior workplace practice and headquarters response for current location.

turns.what: The parties can check whether staff received it.
